unlockLines: SpoofBook unlocked. Today you are a teacher, tomorrow a boss, always a disappointment. Finally, your acting career has a phone extension.
Try on a new identity, beta. Make it someone with punctuality. That would be your most ambitious character yet.
The theatre department is open. Our stage is a phone, our reviews are brutal, and the director wears an unreasonable gold chain.
Be whoever the call needs. You have spent all week pretending to be employed, so the training is already complete.
New voice. New role. Same fucking chair. Method acting has never been this sweaty or this aggressively supervised.
title: SpoofBook
